scenario.description: A concert producer must approve the final production plan for a one-night orchestral film-score performance, including the ensemble size, intermission timing, overhead scenic elements, and rehearsal period.

shared_context.S1: The one-night orchestral film-score performance begins at 7:30 PM in the Grand Hall.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the final call on the production plan.
shared_context.S3: The current production sheet lists 18 musicians, two suspended scenic frames, and a rehearsal from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
shared_context.S4: The production team holds a final pre-show huddle in which the music, rigging, and artist leads report changes, and Mara records approved revisions in the production sheet.
shared_context.S5: When recording follow-up commitments, the team uses specific action labels rather than generic labels such as "open_item" or "action_item"; each commitment target is the individual responsible person's name, such as Julian, Sofia, Dev, or Mara.
shared_context.S6: For this production sheet, acceptable specific action labels include "production_sheet_update", "contract_additional_musicians", "agreement", "rigging_plan_revision", "file_revised_load_plan", "call_sheet_update", and "update_call_sheet".

PF1.text: Julian confirmed this morning that the signed musicians agreement for this repertoire requires exactly 24 players and a 20-minute break from 8:15 PM to 8:35 PM; he has not yet entered the amendment in the production sheet.

PF2.text: Sofia's certified rigging inspection found that the overhead points may carry no more than 450 kg in total, while the two planned scenic frames and their rigging hardware would weigh 510 kg; one frame weighing 240 kg is within the certified limit, and Sofia has not yet filed the revised load plan.

PF3.text: Dev confirmed with the conductor's agent that the conductor and soloist are available for only a 90-minute rehearsal from 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM on performance day; this availability has not yet been added to the call sheet.

acceptance_conditions: The final plan must use exactly 24 musicians.
The performance break must run from exactly 8:15 PM to exactly 8:35 PM.
The plan must use exactly one suspended scenic frame.
The rehearsal must run from exactly 3:00 PM to exactly 4:30 PM.
A specific Sofia-targeted commitment must be recorded for the revised load plan.
A specific Julian-targeted commitment must be recorded for the musicians agreement update.
A specific Dev-targeted commitment must be recorded for the call-sheet or rehearsal update.

content_checks.C2: (decisions['break_start'] == '8:15 PM' and decisions['break_end'] == '8:35 PM') or (decisions['break_start'] == '20:15' and decisions['break_end'] == '20:35')
content_checks.C4: (decisions['rehearsal_start'] == '3:00 PM' and decisions['rehearsal_end'] == '4:30 PM') or (decisions['rehearsal_start'] == '15:00' and decisions['rehearsal_end'] == '16:30')
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Sofia' and c['type'] in ['rigging_plan_revision', 'file_revised_load_plan', 'production_sheet_update'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Julian' and c['type'] in ['musician_contracting', 'contract_additional_musicians', 'program_structuring', 'agreement', 'production_sheet_update'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Dev' and c['type'] in ['call_sheet_update', 'update_call_sheet', 'rehearsal_notification', 'production_sheet_update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed musicians agreement changes the ensemble from 18 to exactly 24 players, fixes the break at 8:15 PM-8:35 PM, and requires a Julian-targeted agreement or production-sheet update commitment.
The certified 450 kg limit makes the planned 510 kg two-frame configuration unacceptable, so the plan must use one frame and include a Sofia-targeted rigging or revised-load-plan commitment.
The confirmed 3:00 PM-4:30 PM availability changes the rehearsal from the draft 4:00 PM-5:00 PM period and requires a Dev-targeted call-sheet or rehearsal-update commitment.
